title: Golden Sunrise Tomato - 2x Mini Plug Plants Sweet Yellow Heirloom Cordon Variety
description:
Golden Sunrise Tomato – 2x Mini Plug Plants
A beautiful British heirloom variety widely regarded as one of the best-flavoured yellow tomatoes you can grow. Golden Sunrise produces prolific trusses of medium-sized, bright golden-yellow fruits with a sweet, fruity, wonderfully juicy flavour.
Perfect sliced fresh into salads where their vibrant colour really stands out, and equally delicious cooked down into mild, golden sauces. A real talking point on the plate.
This indeterminate cordon variety thrives in a greenhouse, polytunnel, or a warm sunny spot outdoors. An early and reliable cropper, expect a generous harvest from July right through to October. Fruits are ready to pick when they turn a deep, vibrant golden yellow. As a cordon type, plants will need staking and regular side-shooting to get the best results.
Happy in pots, grow bags, or planted directly into borders — a versatile choice for growers of all experience levels.
You will receive 2x small plug plants, carefully packaged for safe delivery. Plants are young and vigorous, ready to pot on or plant out once risk of frost has passed.
